title: Video Editor
summary: Own our weekly post-production pipeline: longform Bitcoin podcast edits, social highlight clips and research-heavy shortform YouTube videos.

facts.label: Core stack
facts.value: Adobe Premiere Pro (After Effects / Remotion / Hyperframes are a plus)

blocks.text: Pod21 LLC is a US-based media production company producing video podcasts and high-production shortform edits centered on Bitcoin and freedom technology.

We are looking for a remote Video Editor based in Mexico to manage our weekly post-production pipeline. You will take pre-mastered audio, raw video recordings, and structured brand assets to deliver sharp longform podcast episodes, social highlight clips, and research-heavy shortform YouTube videos that effectively communicate complex technical and monetary concepts.
All work is project-based and paid per completed deliverable. Partial or full payment in bitcoin is available on request.

items.description: 1x full video podcast edit + 2x social highlight clips (estimated ~8 total hours).
Assemble multi-cam video edit and perform basic audio leveling (recordings arrive AI-pre-mastered).
Review the raw recording to curate 6 to 8 candidate selects/hooks for team review, from which 2 final clips will be approved and cut.

Craft a dynamic, high-pacing edit incorporating curated found footage, creative asset research (sourcing relevant news clips, charts, and archival footage), slick transitions, and kinetic text/graphic highlights.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.
Ability to independently source relevant found footage, archive clips, and visual assets that elevate complex narrative topics.
Title animations, text highlighting, and lower-third graphics (within Premiere, After Effects, or another suitable software).
Fluency in English (written and spoken) for clear asynchronous collaboration.
Strong deadline discipline and an editing rig capable of smooth 1080p editing.

items.term: Interest in bitcoin and open source
items.description: A foundational understanding of (or willingness to learn about) bitcoin and open-source technology.

items: Familiarity with Adobe After Effects, Remotion, or Hyperframes.

items.description: Work your own hours as long as key delivery dates are met.
You will receive a brand kit (lower thirds, intro/outro stingers, fonts, color palettes).
Assets managed via shared cloud storage (you will be onboarded upon hire).
You will begin immediately on live production projects; the first few deliverables serve as an open-ended trial for long-term contracting.
Contractor must be registered with SAT (RESICO preferred) and capable of issuing valid invoices (CFDI / international invoice) to a US entity.

howToApply.intro: Get in touch through our contact form and include:
items: A link to your portfolio / showreel, highlighting YouTube-style narrative editing, found-footage integration, and dynamic text graphics.
A short note briefly confirming your experience with Premiere Pro, your general availability, and your interest or familiarity with Bitcoin and freedom technology.
